head.t: Ferno wins Welsh Ambulance Service order for scoop stretchers and head immobilisers
head.x: The Welsh Ambulance Service Trust has directly awarded Ferno (UK) a £58,501 (ex VAT) order for 50 Combi Head Immobilisers and 50 lightweight scoop stretchers, naming Ferno as the OEM. The call-off used NHS Supply Chain's Operating Theatres Equipment and Related Accessories and Services framework.
